summary: BNB Plus Corp. filed an 8-K/A amending its October 1, 2026 current report solely to correct an administrative error on the cover page, which had misidentified its listing venue as Nasdaq rather than the OTCQB Venture Market. The underlying Item 1.01 discloses a September 28, 2026 Second Amendment to the May 26, 2026 Registration Rights Agreement with holders of 50.1% or more of registrable securities. The amendment replaces the company's affirmative registration filing deadline with a demand-based right, allowing holders of at least 51% to make up to two demands, with a 45-day filing obligation and a mutual waiver and release of prior defaults. This is a routine contractual/registration-rights matter, not a special situation.
